summary: General Date.parse first ToStrings its argument and must preserve implementation-defined parsing extensions when the string is not a standard Date Time String Format.

target.notes: Reuse canonical ToString. Compatibility runtime must choose/emulate a JavaScript engine policy for permitted non-standard forms.

semantics.coercion: ToString, potentially user code for objects

caveats: Do not claim cross-engine portability for implementation-defined date strings.

tests.name: non-standard input cannot assume CLR parser
tests.expected_behavior: result follows the selected JavaScript compatibility policy and may differ across engines
